question: Under a parent-disjoint TRAIN-only protocol, can a lightweight replaceable encoder recover every declared continuous R2 factor and calibrated uncertainty independently of final task geometry, with no factor failure hidden or rescued by reducer outputs?
principle: F0 PASS purchases eligibility to design F1, not eligibility to train F1.

data_partitions.identity_basis: Read-only capability counts from the governed 16-parent TRAIN atlas; no F1 sample roster is allocated by this protocol.

supervision_admission_contract.coverage_before_any_optimizer: Every admitted sample serializes all schema fields, validity masks and provenance; unsupported values are MASKED_UNKNOWN.
supervision_admission_contract.factor_value_coverage: Each required factor family must have nonzero valid support in FIT, CHECKPOINT_SELECTION and TRAIN_CANARY roles.
supervision_admission_contract.unknown_policy: UNKNOWN is excluded from factor-value losses and metrics; only the declared validity head may learn validity=false.
supervision_admission_contract.provenance_policy: Only registered metric geometry or sensor-derived factor truth is allowed; teacher, model consensus, final task state and B1 Development outcomes are forbidden.
supervision_admission_contract.label_transform_freeze: Every derivation, distance transform, normalization, residual target, mask and source SHA must be frozen in a separate successor before execution.

loss_contract.optimizer_objective_formula: Equal mean of per-component losses after dividing each by its FIT-only nonlearned-baseline scale frozen before model initialization.

components.formula: Charbonnier error on centered log-depth shape
Huber error on log metric scale after frozen geometric-mean decomposition
Proper Gaussian NLL on valid log-depth residuals
Brier score for explicit source validity only
Brier score on explicitly known support truth
Geodesic angular error on valid unit normals
Huber error on valid log camera height
Proper Gaussian NLL on valid support-plane residuals
Brier score for explicit support validity only
Brier score on explicitly known obstacle evidence
Brier score on boundary membership derived by the frozen continuous distance transform
Proper Gaussian NLL on valid boundary localization residuals
Brier score for explicit boundary/evidence validity only

checkpoint_selection_contract.eligibility: No factor-specific primary metric may be worse than its frozen nonlearned baseline; at least one must improve.
checkpoint_selection_contract.selection: Among eligible checkpoints, minimize the maximum factor-specific normalized regret; retain the full Pareto table.

factor_learnability_metrics.aggregation: Compute within parent first, then parent macro; frames are not independent evidence.

frontdoor_before_metrics: serialized factor output field coverage equals 1.0
no forbidden final-task field or reducer gradient path
all three parent-disjoint TRAIN roles satisfy every factor-family denominator
f1_success_rule.per_factor_rule: For every factor family independently, paired TRAIN_CANARY parent-macro improvement over its frozen nonlearned baseline has 10,000-parent-bootstrap 95% lower confidence bound greater than zero and at least 75% of eligible parents have the favorable sign.
f1_success_rule.uncertainty_rule: Each predicted uncertainty family improves proper score over its homoscedastic baseline and observed residual magnitude is nondecreasing across frozen predicted-uncertainty quantiles.
f1_success_rule.seed_rule: All predeclared seeds are reported; no best-seed selection. Exact seeds and count require a later execution lock.

f1_kill_gates.condition: Any schema drift, final-task field, reducer gradient path or task target is present.
Any factor family, role, mask, provenance or denominator is absent or undefined.
Any uncertainty proper-score or ordering rule fails.
Candidate schedule, baseline, Pareto table or tie rule is missing or outcome-informed.
Reducer/task output, threshold tuning, extra seed, extra epoch, teacher, temporal or mobile module is used to rescue a failed factor gate.

current_execution_blockers: Continuous obstacle-boundary truth is 0 frames / 0 parents.
Complete R2 factor-schema truth is 0 frames / 0 parents.
Current support source reaches only 11 parents, below the frozen 12 joint-parent minimum.
Parent-disjoint FIT/CHECKPOINT_SELECTION/TRAIN_CANARY roster is not frozen.
Canonical label materializer, uncertainty residual contract and provenance receipts are not frozen.
Model identity, nonlearned baselines, loss normalization values, checkpoint schedule, seeds and optimizer budget are intentionally unresolved.

preconditions: A separately authorized F1 execution reaches the F1 PASS terminal without any factor-family failure.
The selected F1 checkpoint and every factor metric/receipt are frozen.
F0 reducer code/profile remain byte-identical or a new F0 version is run.
A separate F2 protocol and new Development roster are frozen before outcome access.
f2_admission.downstream_failure_attribution: F0 covers frozen reducer mechanics; F1 covers factor recovery; F2 may then examine factor coupling, calibration and distribution shift.

unique_successor.scope: Freeze a parent-complete TRAIN-only supervision source, continuous-boundary label transform, residual-based uncertainty scoring contract, provenance receipts and role roster. Do not define a model or run training.

frozen_now: factor prediction and supervision field schema
independent factor loss formulas and reporting
parent-disjoint TRAIN-internal roles and minimum counts
checkpoint selection formula and tie rule
factor-first F1 success rule and kill gates
current data capability matrix and F1 non-authority
unresolved_before_execution: complete supervision source and materializer identity
exact parent identities and role assignment
FIT-only nonlearned baselines and normalization values
checkpoint schedule, optimizer, steps, seeds and compute budget

constraints.description: This lock may create only protocol, schema, static validation and current authority facts; it may not create or execute learning artifacts.
Every admitted sample and factor family has complete fields, masks and provenance before any optimizer step.
constraints.rationale: Prevents missing factor evidence from being hidden by selective denominators.
constraints.calibration_source: Schema completeness invariant fixed before execution.
constraints.sensitivity_plan: No lower threshold is allowed; unsupported values remain UNKNOWN.
constraints.revision_policy: Any weakening requires a new hypothesis version.

constraints.description: Depth/scale, support and boundary/evidence each pass independently; aggregate or downstream task metrics cannot compensate.
constraints.rationale: Makes factor identifiability the F1 question rather than final Assistive Geometry performance.
constraints.calibration_source: Pre-outcome causal decomposition of the R2 hypothesis.
constraints.sensitivity_plan: Report every component and parent sign; do not scalarize failures.
constraints.revision_policy: A failed family stops this execution version and cannot be rescued in place.

constraints.description: Even an eventual F1 PASS may only authorize freezing a separate F2 protocol and never opens Development automatically.

experiment_design.minimal_discriminating_experiment: A future, separately authorized parent-disjoint TRAIN-only run must establish each continuous factor family and uncertainty independently over frozen nonlearned baselines before the F0 reducer is used for task evaluation.
experiment_design.resource_budget: This lock: static JSON and Python validation only. Future model/training/optimizer budget is deliberately absent and therefore unauthorized.
experiment_design.stop_conditions: Stop before optimizer while any supervision, roster, baseline, model, checkpoint schedule, seed or compute identity remains unresolved; after execution, stop on the first independent factor kill gate.

hypotheses.theoretical_or_empirical_basis: Continuous metric depth/scale, support geometry and boundary evidence expose separable residuals and proper uncertainty scores, unlike a direct discrete final-task target.
hypotheses.causal_difference: The learned graph predicts only declared factor fields; the frozen F0 reducer and every final task state are outside the graph and outside F1 checkpoint selection.
hypotheses.expected_information_gain: Identifies whether failure belongs to depth/scale, support, boundary/evidence or uncertainty before any end-to-end task test.
hypotheses.minimal_test: Parent-disjoint TRAIN FIT, CHECKPOINT_SELECTION and TRAIN_CANARY roles with independent per-factor baselines, metrics and conjunctive gates.
hypotheses.evaluation_metric: Parent-macro factor errors and proper-score gains with bootstrap lower bounds and parent sign concordance; no reducer task metric.
hypotheses.falsifier: Any factor family lacks valid supervision, fails to beat its frozen baseline, has uncalibrated uncertainty, or requires a final-task shortcut/downstream rescue.
hypotheses.resource_budget: No model or training budget in F1-P; a future execution lock must bind all identities and budget.
hypotheses.stop_condition: Kill the F1 execution version on any independent factor failure and do not admit F2.
hypotheses.selection_reason: It is the minimum experiment that tests whether R2 factors are identifiable and learnable without collapsing back into end-to-end task-label prediction.

successor_policy.successor_scope: Protocol/schema work only; no label materialization, model, trainer or optimizer until separately authorized.

claim_ceiling: F1-P static protocol, factor schema, current TRAIN supervision capability and non-authority only. No F1 model, label materialization, optimizer, checkpoint, factor learnability, reducer task utility, F2, Development, teacher, temporal, mobile/device, Calibration, Confirmation, product or safety evidence.
